statement: Model Name: Forus
Developer: Forus, Inc. (formerly Tandem / Tandem Technology, Inc.), based in New York, NY.
Developer: Forus, Inc. (formerly Tandem / Tandem Technology, Inc.), based in New York, NY.
Regulatory Approval Status: Not an FDA-authorized medical device; administrative medication-access / prior-authorization workflow platform (consumer/provider tooling).
Availability: Free for providers and patients in the United States; supports practices in all 50 states and works with any EHR.

Summary: Forus is an AI-powered medication access platform that automates steps from prescription to affordable treatment—prior authorizations, appeals, enrollment forms, benefit verifications, pharmacy routing, affordability programs, and patient communication—so patients can start therapy faster.

Medical Purpose: Accelerate and simplify patient access to prescribed medications by automating administrative medication-access workflows (including pharmacy-benefit and buy-and-bill support) across drugs, insurance plans, and pharmacies.

Output: Automated prior authorizations, customized appeal letters, enrollment forms, pharmacy routing, benefit verifications, affordability/financial assistance options, and patient/provider status updates.

Known Performance Limitations: Forus focuses on medication access / prior authorization workflows; it is not a diagnostic or treatment-recommendation clinical AI. Performance: Provider-facing metrics reported by Forus include ~1.1 median days to prior authorization approval in featured practices, ~3× more authorizations completed per day, and ~2× greater success filling first-line prescriptions. Family Allergy & Asthma reported cutting PA turnaround from 7+ days to 1.1 days and ~70% lower per-patient admin workload; DOCS Dermatology reported same-day submissions with approvals in <1 day.
